change: Unified display metadata packet written to DDR fixed byte address 0x01000000 (DDR word address 0x00200000).
Packet carries magic/version, effect mask, three effect-order slots, peak, voices, status, analysis sequence/skipped and frame status.
HDMI effect cards use the shared order fields and now show explicit right-pointing arrows between cards.

Effect order commands 84/85/86 are accepted through the existing event protocol; audio remains the previously accepted fixed serial path while dynamic audio reordering is held for a separate timing-safe change.
